annotations.title: Set what happens to unanswered calls

description: Sets what happens when this seat declines a call, does not answer it, or is busy: voicemail, busy, decline, end, or ai_receptionist. ai_receptionist rings the seat first, then hands the call to the AI receptionist or phone menu in menu_id (Business).

menu_id.description: AI receptionist or phone menu id, for ai_receptionist.
